title: 4521-ESP-AGE-74-70-0004 R1
summary:

- Definitions include Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, and Owner.
- The contract includes packaging, labeling, and delivery requirements.
- Confidentiality measures are in place for the information contained within.
- Alternate billing cycles can be requested by the owner.

- Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle is included with contact information for the owner's designated agent.

- Quotation must specify time required for approval drawings and fabrication after drawing approval.
- Equipment to be delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site with specific locations to be released later.
- Shipment is required by a strict delivery schedule finalized at the time of final contract materialization, best estimated shipping date August 2012.
summary_points: This document outlines the scope of work for instrument supply for the Solana project.
Definitions include Supplier, Customer, Fabricator, and Owner.
The contract includes packaging, labeling, and delivery requirements.
Confidentiality measures are in place for the information contained within.
Alternate billing cycles can be requested by the owner.
RFQ No., Job, Spec No., Item No. and Project details are provided.
Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle is included with contact information for the owner's designated agent.
All material must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards; non-compliant materials will be returned at Supplier's expense.
Vendor data requirements include completion of 'Vendor Commitment' column in the form.
Quotation must specify time required for approval drawings and fabrication after drawing approval.
Equipment to be delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site with specific locations to be released later.
Shipment is required by a strict delivery schedule finalized at the time of final contract materialization, best estimated shipping date August 2012.
A list of recommended spare parts for one year's normal maintenance is required with price and delivery details.
Equipment and components will undergo inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
Vendor recommendations to improve price, delivery or performance are solicited.
Three pressure gauges specified for the Ullage Cleaning System.
Tag numbers include PG 206-08, PG 206-09, and PG 206-19.
All gauges are of Bourdon type with a range of 0-400 psig.
Design pressure varies between 200-400 psig for different gauges.
Material used includes 316 SS for pressure elements and case.
Glass material is shatterproof, and blow-out protection is provided.
Calibration by vendor required with a certificate of calibration.
Pressure gauge models include MGS 30/3/A DS 4 1/2" and MGS 9/500.
Flushing ring size is 2" 300 # RF with a drain port of 3/4" NPT.
All pressure gauges must be calibrated by the vendor, requiring a certificate.
The instrument tag number is PG 206-20 for MV-208 Overflow Tank HTF Scrubber inlet pressure.
Design pressure and temperature are 400 psig and 350°F respectively.
Nominal accuracy of the gauge is ± 0.5% of span x range.
